meta.name: Blogum Newspaper Blog Magazine WordPress Theme Design DNA
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from the public ThemeForest item page for Blogum. The full-screen preview URL was protected by Cloudflare in command-line access, so visual values combine official feature descriptions, item metadata, and conservative inference from the listed editorial/magazine system.
meta.confidence: medium: official item page was accessible, full interactive preview was blocked by Cloudflare challenge

primary.role: dominant ink color for headlines, navigation, dividers, and brutalist editorial framing

secondary.role: warm paper-like background surface for magazine layouts

accent.role: breaking news labels, progress bar, active states, and urgent editorial calls to action

neutral.usage: large light editorial surfaces, near-black text, subtle beige-gray dividers, and grayscale media treatments

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast dark-on-light with occasional inverted black panels and sharp red editorial accents

font_families.heading: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Abril Fatface, Georgia, serif

typography.font_style_notes: luxury editorial serif display paired with clean modern sans body; optional condensed sans for ticker, labels, and magazine metadata

spacing.content_density: comfortable editorial density with compact metadata rows and generous feature-story breathing room
spacing.section_rhythm: large vertical editorial blocks, tight card internals, and strong separation between feature, feed, ticker, and archive modules

layout.grid_system: split-screen magazine architecture with sticky left cover panel and scrollable right content feed
layout.max_content_width: 1440px overall, 680px to 920px reading column depending on module
layout.columns: desktop split pane plus 2-4 column modular grids, masonry, bento, mosaic, and list variants
layout.alignment_tendency: strict editorial grid with controlled asymmetry from split panes and mosaic story placement

shape.border_usage: subtle to strong 1px editorial rules, card separators, framed images, and module boundaries
shape.divider_style: thin hairline dividers in black or warm gray, sometimes used as strong newspaper-like rules

elevation.shadow_style: minimal; depth mostly comes from contrast, image scale, sticky layering, and occasional shadow tile modules
elevation.depth_cues: sticky panels, overlay text on media, grayscale-to-color image treatment, clipped reveals, and occasional glass/archive modules

iconography.style: minimal line icons for social share, navigation, search, and utility actions

motion.entrance_pattern: IntersectionObserver-triggered fade-up, clip reveal, image zoom, and cover-panel cinematic transitions
motion.exit_pattern: quick fade or slide out, especially for overlays and up-next strips
motion.philosophy: cinematic but performance-aware editorial motion without heavy dependency on animation libraries

components.button_style: sharp rectangular ghost buttons, black filled buttons, and red label-style CTAs with uppercase metadata styling
components.input_style: minimal underlined or 1px bordered fields, square corners, high contrast focus state
components.card_style: image-led editorial cards with category labels, reading time, bold title hierarchy, and restrained borders
components.navigation_pattern: sticky or persistent magazine navigation with responsive overlay menu on mobile
components.modal_style: minimal high-contrast overlay with editorial typography and simple close icon
components.list_style: condensed post lists, ticker rows, author lists, timeline feed, and refined category blocks
components.component_notes: system supports post masonry, deck scroll, bento grids, four-column mosaic, cinematic strip, card flip, category carousel, FAQ accordion, weather metric, login, newsletter, author profiles, and up-next strip

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a luxury newspaper or magazine cover pinned beside a live digital article feed
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary digital publishing with print magazine, brutalist, and high-fashion editorial references
aesthetic.genre: luxury editorial news and magazine theme

visual_language.ornamentation: functional editorial ornamentation through rules, labels, ticker motion, cover effects, and typographic contrast
visual_language.whitespace_usage: controlled whitespace: broad around feature stories, tighter inside feeds and utility modules
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy left cover or hero image balanced by dense right-side editorial modules
visual_language.focal_strategy: persistent feature cover plus distributed interest across story cards and tickers
visual_language.texture_usage: photo grain, grayscale imagery, paper-like warmth, and occasional glass/archive surface effects

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy reinforced by image scale, pane ownership, labels, and rule lines
composition.balance_type: asymmetric split-screen with modular grid balancing
composition.flow_direction: left feature anchor to right scroll feed, then vertical progression through modules
composition.grouping_strategy: stories grouped by category, module type, feed density, and image prominence
composition.negative_space_role: creates premium editorial pacing and isolates marquee stories

imagery.photo_treatment: large editorial photography, optional grayscale mode, cover zoom/pan, video backgrounds, and hover transforms
imagery.illustration_style: rare; design favors photography and typographic systems over illustration
imagery.graphic_elements: ticker strips, progress bars, category chips, thin rules, framed media, and magazine metadata
imagery.pattern_usage: minimal; any patterning is secondary to grids, photo texture, and typographic rhythm
imagery.image_shape: mostly rectangular, full-bleed, square-cornered, with occasional circular author/profile modules

interaction_feel.feedback_style: clear and editorial: category color, hover image movement, active ticker/progress feedback
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: image zoom, grayscale/color shift, underline reveal, card lift or flip for special modules
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth cinematic glide with occasional sharp brutalist snap
interaction_feel.loading_style: minimal skeleton or fade-in; emphasis on zero layout shift

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative with urgent news-room energy
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: clean editorial placeholder with concise guidance

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce advanced cover effects to static images, disable video backgrounds, preserve layout and typography
overview.primary_technology: CSS transitions, native JavaScript, IntersectionObserver, optional HTML5 video

background_effects.description: sticky left cover panel supports Ken Burns, cinematic pan, glitch, tilt, soft blur-in, and native MP4 video backgrounds
background_effects.technology: CSS transforms, CSS filters, native JavaScript, HTML5 video

params.blend_mode: normal or multiply for grayscale editorial looks

particle_systems.description: no particle system is indicated by the public item page

3d_elements.description: no WebGL or 3D model rendering is indicated

shader_effects.description: glitch and liquid gallery effects may be CSS/JS based; no custom GLSL evidence from public item page

parallax.speed_curve: slow background drift against normal content scroll

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: module entrance, story card entrance, image reveal, stats counters, FAQ accordion
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: fade-up, clip-reveal, zoom, counter, ticker, deck-scroll
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: mostly trigger-based, occasional sticky/deck scroll behavior

scroll_morphing.description: post deck scroll, up-next strip, reading progress bar, and sticky cover create scroll-dependent interface changes

text_effects.description: breaking news ticker, kinetic marquee, text marquee variants, large serif headline scale contrast

params.animation_per_unit: horizontal translate for ticker; fade/clip for headline reveals
params.effect_style: newsroom ticker plus cinematic editorial headline reveal

cursor_effects.description: no custom cursor behavior is indicated

image_effects.type: grayscale, zoom, clip reveal, tilt, flip, liquid gallery
image_effects.description: media system includes grayscale editorial mode, cinematic cover pan, hover grids, card flip animation, parallax slabs, liquid gallery, and video frame modules
image_effects.technology: CSS filters, CSS transforms, native JavaScript, optional video

params.filter_pipeline: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) or normal color; optional blur-in for cover
params.hover_transform: scale(1.04), translateY(-2px), tilt, or card flip depending on module
params.reveal_animation: clip-path inset reveal or opacity/transform reveal
params.distortion_type: liquid or glitch listed as module/effect, implementation unconfirmed

glassmorphism_neumorphism.style: glass archive and glass gallery modules

canvas_drawings.description: no canvas drawing layer is confirmed by public item page

svg_animations.description: icons and decorative rules may use SVG, but no explicit SVG animation is described

visual_effects.composite_notes: The defining effect stack is not a WebGL spectacle; it is an editorial interaction system: sticky split-screen cover, scroll-fed content, ticker motion, reading progress, grayscale media, cinematic cover transforms, and dense modular story widgets. Values should be re-sampled if the protected full-screen preview becomes accessible in a logged-in browser session.
